customManagers.description: Update a cask's version and checksum from its release

transformTemplates: {"releases": $map($[draft = false and prerelease = false], function($release) {($tag := $release.tag_name; $asset := $release.assets[name = ("Alacritty-" & $tag & ".dmg")][0]; $asset ? {"version": $substring($tag, 1), "releaseTimestamp": $release.published_at, "changelogUrl": $release.html_url, "sourceUrl": "https://github.com/alacritty/alacritty", "digest": $asset.digest ? $substringAfter($asset.digest, "sha256:") : undefined})})}

{"releases": $map($[draft = false and prerelease = false], function($release) {($tag := $release.tag_name; $asset := $release.assets[name = ("NotchAssistant-" & $substring($tag, 1) & "-arm64.zip")][0]; $asset ? {"version": $substring($tag, 1), "releaseTimestamp": $release.published_at, "changelogUrl": $release.html_url, "sourceUrl": "https://github.com/shmileee/notch-assistant", "digest": $asset.digest ? $substringAfter($asset.digest, "sha256:") : undefined})})}
